title: Audiobook-to-sentence envelope reconstruction

titles: MEG-SCANS speech, chirps and noisy sentences

scientific_question: Can an audiobook-trained neural decoder reconstruct the acoustic envelope of a different spoken sentence?
primary_outputs: Sample-aligned predicted envelope for every permitted sentence interval.

data_manifest.manifest_scope: First 1000 keys only, not total storage.

recording_contract.neural: Raw and MaxFilter-preprocessed FIF streams; actual representative raw/derivative files and event tables were inspected.
recording_contract.labels: Sentence events contain onset,duration,value,sample,trial_type,SNR,intelligibility,stim_file,sentence; processed OLSA acoustic envelopes are available.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Author pipeline trains at 1000-to-64 Hz downsampled neural/acoustic resolution, applies documented 3 ms alignment correction, and supplies sentence-event timing. Alignment must be rechecked before trials are packaged.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 24 participants in actual participants.tsv; each participant has audiobook/chirp/sentence tasks and multiple runs, not separate cohorts.
recording_contract.evidence: Prior source audit inspected OpenNeuro manifest, exact event/participant text and speech decoding loaders.

biological_unit: 24 participants in actual participants.tsv; each participant has audiobook/chirp/sentence tasks and multiple runs, not separate cohorts.
case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: Group whole audiobook/sentence runs and repeated sentence identities; fit on training runs, evaluate different sentences; outer group person. Any target-person calibration has a fixed labeled budget.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Person-macro Fisher-z correlation on whole held-out sentences; report raw correlations too.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
